seed_ids.label: Portrait of Eve
seed_ids.selection: First numeric artwork ID with createdBy, hasStyle, hasGenre, and madeOf facts.

filter_rules.algorithm: Deterministic breadth-first extraction over the validated object-property allowlist; RDF extraction is not recommendation inference.
filter_rules.stable_topic_id: ag_ + the numeric ArtGraph resource fragment
filter_rules.stable_fact_id: agf_ + first 20 hex characters of SHA-256(subject + unit-separator + predicate + unit-separator + object)

license_status: UNRESOLVED: the Zenodo v1.0 record displayed a blank Rights/License field when inspected on 2026-10-26. Do not redistribute bulk RDF or images until clarified. This repository retains only a 32-triple text sample needed to reproduce the pilot proof.
extraction_process: Stream the RDF member and stop at the appended ':POST http://localhost:7474/' marker; retain and hash every preceding line.
Select the first qualifying artwork by numeric resource ID.
Extract a bounded connected sample using scripts/extract_subgraph.py.
Write sorted RDF, a shared topic catalog, and provenance-bearing Prolog facts.
schema_observations: The facts file appends a malformed Neo4j request and preview after the full graph.
The bundled ontology declares madeFrom and belongToMovement, but the populated facts use madeOf and belongsToMovement; import follows the populated facts.
The parsed counts differ slightly from the record-page summary for Gallery and Period resources; docs/artgraph_audit.json is the executed census.
processing_script_commit_note: The repository had no commits during Phase 0; record a commit hash after review/acceptance.
